addition.item: Protected catalogues: new option "Protect files". Only visitors with the module's access level can open the PDFs; direct links are blocked and Joomla delivers PDFs and thumbnails after an access check.
Protected catalogues may be stored in an absolute folder outside the web root (recommended on nginx).
Notices for administrators if the protection is not effective (folder not writable, foreign .htaccess, server ignores .htaccess, access level "Public").
Single-language sites: PDFs can be placed directly in the main folder when there are no language subfolders.
Setup notice for logged-in administrators when the folder does not exist or no PDFs were found.

change.item: Clearer description of the folder structure in the module settings and the documentation.

addition.item: First public release: PDF catalogue list (list, grid and downloads layouts) with cover thumbnails.
Built-in flipbook viewer based on PDF.js 6.2.108 – no external services, no cookies, no tracking.
Colour settings for accent, toolbar and page background; adjustable flip duration.
Viewer interface in 10 languages (DE, EN, FR, ES, IT, NL, PL, PT, CS, TR).
